items.title: Commission preliminarily finds Temu in breach of the Digital Services Act for failure to tackle the sale of illegal products
items.description: Commission preliminarily finds Temu in breach of the Digital Services Act for failure to tackle the sale of illegal products Anonymous (not verified) Tue, 11/17/2026 - 11:11 The European Commission preliminarily found Temu in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) obligation to put in place reasonable, proportionate and effective measures to mitigate the risk of illegal products being offered on its platform. The Commission preliminarily found that Temu's mitigation measures include ineffective controls to check the compliance of products; a weak content moderation system; and an ineffective sanction system. Henna Virkkunen, Executive Vice-President for Tech Sovereignty, Security and Democracy, said: Shopping online should not mean risking the purchase of illegal and unsafe products. items.title: Commission hosts Apply AI Summit to boost Europe’s AI innovation and uptake
items.description: Commission hosts Apply AI Summit to boost Europe’s AI innovation and uptake Anonymous (not verified) Mon, 11/16/2026 - 13:43 Nearly 1,000 high-level policymakers, start-ups, industry leaders and researchers will take part in the Apply AI Summit in Brussels tomorrow. They will discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) can boost Europe’s competitiveness across 10 strategic sectors and the public sector. The summit will also showcase concrete AI applications, European success stories and innovative projects. Henna Virkkunen , Executive Vice-President for Technological Sovereignty, Security and Democracy, will host the summit and present the first Apply AI Startup Award to three European start-ups.
